provider.original_observation: I re-read the current ObserverApp.swift and ObserverTests.swift source. The app calls ObserverBridge.make directly as the first child of one eager VStack in its single vertical ScrollView, showsIndicators:false. The component is followed immediately by the final __observer.bottom staticText, with no later scroll content. Host padding is horizontal16/top24 and the ScrollView frame uses requested width and height600; fixed private metadata requests width390, light/ltr/large. Fixture/receipt/runtime controls are outside this region. The actual test-source full sweep calls capture(boundaryRequired:true); a reached terminal is resolved by unique native staticText query and exports the current frame and executed XCUIElement.isHittable with the input/event binding. Original raster/native registration separately rejects missing top, terminal ancestry/geometry, current hittability guard or content-end extent. This is source conformance, not an observation that any private run achieved those runtime facts.
